sloka: वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल ।प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः ॥२-२९-१२॥
transliteration: vana vāse hi jānāmi duhkhāni bahudhā kila ।prāpyante niyatam vīra puruṣaiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ ॥2-29-12॥

translations.english: I am aware, O valiant one, that there are hardships of every kind in forest life. But they befall those whose senses are not under their control.
